name: Eat Snakes Simulator
desc:
🔴 Welcome to Eat Snakes Simulator! 🔴 

Winter Update!
🎄 USE CODES:  SNOWFLAKE, SANTA, PRESENTS
🎁 MORE PRESENTS TO COLLECT!

How to Play: 
🏃‍ Collect food on the Ground 🏃‍ 
⚔️ Defeat players smaller than you ⚔️ 
💀 Collect Skulls to unlock Rare Skins 💀 
🏆 Become the Strongest in the game 🏆

Collect orbs and defeat weaker players to become the best blob in this awesome collecting simulator! 
Important: All purchases except for skulls are not permanent and last for 1 life.
